1. **Keep a consistent sleep schedule.** Go to bed and wake up at the same times every day, even on weekends. This trains your circadian rhythm so your body knows when to wind down.

2. **Make your bedroom cool, dark, and quiet.** Aim for around 18°C (65°F), use a blackout curtain or eye mask, and remove screens at least an hour before bed. A cool, dark room signals your brain that it's time to sleep.
